title: Greeting Bot
brief: Build a friendly robot that talks to people! Your Greeting Bot asks two questions — a name and an age — and then says two things back.

problem.goal: Write a program that asks for a person's name and age, greets them by name, and tells them how old they will be next year.
rules: The greeting must be exactly: Hello, followed by the name, followed by !
The second line must be exactly: Next year you will be, followed by the new age.
Next year's age is the age they typed plus 1.

steps: Lines 1 and 2 are already written for you: they ask the two questions and store the answers in name and age.
Print a greeting that uses name. For Alex it must read: Hello, Alex!
Print how old they will be next year. For a 10 year old it must read: Next year you will be 11
Press Run to try your bot yourself, then press Check Project to test it with 3 different people.
starterCode:
# 🤖 Greeting Bot

# ---- Already done for you ----
# input() shows a question and gives back whatever the person types.
name = input("What is your name? ")

# int() turns the typed text into a real number, so we can do math with it.
age = int(input("How old are you? "))


# ---- Your turn! ----

# TODO 1: print a greeting that uses name.
#         For Alex it must read:  Hello, Alex!


# TODO 2: print how old they will be next year.
#         For a 10 year old it must read:  Next year you will be 11
hints: Start small. Add the line print("Hello!") and press Run — you will see it appear in the terminal. That is all print() does: it shows a message.
To stick words together, use + between them. Example: greeting = "Hi, " + "Sam"  →  Hi, Sam. Watch the space inside the quotes — without it you get Hi,Sam.
For TODO 1 you need three pieces glued together: the words "Hello, ", then the variable name, then the "!".
Numbers can't be glued to words directly — Python complains. Wrap the number in str() first. Example: print("I have " + str(3 + 2) + " apples")  →  I have 5 apples
For TODO 2, next year's age is age + 1. So you need the words "Next year you will be " glued to str(age + 1).
inputHint: Your bot asks 2 questions, so type 2 answers: a name on the first line and an age on the second.
successMessage: Your Greeting Bot is ALIVE! 🤖 It asks questions, listens to the answer, does math, and greets everyone correctly. That's a real interactive program — awesome work!
